title: Task Brief authoring convention and Task Explorer
summary: User accepted the Task Brief format and requested public sample acquisition on 2026-09-21. Nine authored briefs, 284 explicitly scoped source entries and native examples for five external repositories plus BR-030. Downloaded 88.4 MB of public sample material and reused 37.3 MB of hash-checked TopCoW data. CT-RATE account access and actual run outputs remain separate gaps.

links.label: Published source inventory and coverage gaps
Public sample download, access and visual receipts

decision_provenance: 2026-09-21 user answers: samples now and all tasks eventually; technically literate audience without specialist medical knowledge; existing and proposed tasks with clear draft marking. Other architecture and visual recommendations are by the assistant and await decisions. Later user response “all your rec” accepted shared definition briefs with case indexes, input-first reference reveals, reusable skill plus repository rulebook/template, and separately authoritative executable contracts. User subsequently requested searching and downloading necessary samples. This authorized bounded public data acquisition, not model trials.
reopen_when: When a source revision or task condition changes, a missing case inventory becomes available, or reader feedback demonstrates a needed format change.
